fomod.Name: LipSync Together (Voice Lip Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Lip sync and optional proximity voice chat for Skyrim Together Reborn. Includes secure session-key and open voice relay choices. Supports STR 1.8.3, 1.8.5 and the 1.8.6 playtest for all listed Skyrim runtimes. Requires Mfg Fix NG or Mfg Fix; neither is included.
